recentItems.title: Mongolia’s Deadly Winter: Two Teenagers Fight to Save an Ancient Tradition | Witness Documentary
recentItems.description:
In Mongolia’s remote Tsakhir Valley, horses mean survival. For generations, herders protected them from winter storms by gathering a vast herd and nominating their bravest young men to protect it. But mounting environmental pressures forced the centuries-old tradition to be abruptly abandoned in 2019, sparking fears that the rite of passage would be lost forever.

Determined to reclaim their heritage, village elders pledge to revive the winter herd and place the daunting responsibility on two teenage friends to safeguard the horses through what becomes Mongolia’s deadliest winter on record. Over several brutal months, the boys battle blizzards, exhaustion and doubt, discovering that in the Iron Winter, nothing can survive alone.

Iron Winter is a documentary film by Kasimir Burgess.

recentItems.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says no major combat operations needed in Iran
recentItems.description:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says no major combat operations are needed in Iran, backing President Donald Trump’s assertion that the US-Israeli war on Iran is effectively over.
Speaking at the G7 foreign ministers’ meeting in Paris, Rubio said economic pressure on Iran is working.

recentItems.title: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth calls impeachment efforts a 'farce’
recentItems.description:

Republican Congressman Thomas Massie has filed eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth, including allegations he broke the law in his handling of the Iran war.

recentItems.title: Bangladesh prosecutor warns Hasina faces execution if she returns | AJ #shorts
recentItems.description:
Bangladesh’s International Crimes Tribunal has said ousted PM Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home. The warning comes as Hasina requested a new passport after earlier vowing to return in December, more than two years after she fled to India amid a mass uprising.

recentItems.title: Al Jazeera investigation finds Israeli soldiers posing as settlers during attacks on Palestinians
recentItems.description:
An Al Jazeera investigation has documented evidence of Israeli soldiers joining settler attacks in civilian clothes and then returning back to the same villages they attacked in military uniforms. Al Jazeera’s Emma Withrow reports how one man identified in the investigation was sanctioned by the US, before Trump lifted those sanctions.
